entrypoints.summary: The disclosed call chain begins with an issues-triggered triage workflow, through a reusable triage action, to claude-code-action; attacker-authored issue body and title are the reported inputs.
In the action's issues case, github.event.issue.body and github.event.issue.title are consumed in the Bash run block.

affected_components.role: Pre-fix Bash run block expression-interpolates issue fields.
symbols: Extract GitHub Context and Create Prompt

affected_components.role: Fixed step maps event fields to env and consumes shell variables.

causal_paths.kind: GitHub issue event fields to generated Bash run script

observability.channel: GitHub Actions job execution and workflow secret exposure
negative_controls: Fixed source reads issue values from quoted environment-backed shell variables.
No runtime execution result or secret-access log is present in the bundle.
observability.positive_marker: The disclosure reports code execution with high privileges and potential ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exfiltration.

preconditions: A repository workflow invokes the disclosed reusable action on the reported issues-event path.
The issue title or body reaches the pre-fix action source.
The report states the workflow has access to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Issue text constructed to escape the intended quoted assignment and introduce shell syntax; no concrete payload is provided in the bundle.
trigger_steps.summary: Submit issue content whose title or body reaches the action's issues-event branch, where the vulnerable source directly interpolates it into Bash assignments.

capabilities.concept: command execution in a secret-bearing CI job

mitigations.concept: environment-variable transport for untrusted workflow event fields

relation_candidates.rationale: The vulnerable issues branch directly inserts issue body and title expressions into Bash assignments.

relation_candidates.dst: command execution in a secret-bearing CI job
relation_candidates.rationale: The disclosure identifies direct expression evaluation in the action's Bash run block and reports high-privilege code execution.
The disclosure states that the workflow has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY access and that the issue may lead to secret exfiltration.
relation_candidates.src: command execution in a secret-bearing CI job

relation_candidates.dst: environment-variable transport for untrusted workflow event fields
relation_candidates.rationale: The fixing commit adds env mappings for event fields and the fixed action reads the corresponding shell variables instead of direct expressions in the issues assignments.

impact.affected_asset: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY available to the disclosed workflow.
impact.attacker_capability: An issue author can supply issue title or body content that reaches the vulnerable issues-event branch and is inserted into the Bash run block.
impact.security_effect: Reported arbitrary code execution in the secret-bearing GitHub Actions job, with possible secret exfiltration.

causal_trace.summary: Issue-body and issue-title event fields are externally authored inputs on the disclosed issues-event path.
The vulnerable action embeds GitHub expression results for issue body and title directly into quoted Bash assignment text, rather than transporting those values through a shell data boundary.
The runner's Bash shell parses the generated run block containing the expression-substituted assignments, allowing issue-derived text to cross into shell program text.
The disclosure reports that code execution in this workflow context can expose and exfiltrate the workflow-accessible ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.

failure.operation: Bash parsing and execution of a run script after GitHub expression interpolation of issue-body and issue-title values

primary_invariant.statement: Externally authored GitHub issue fields must remain data when consumed by the composite action and must not be spliced into Bash program text.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix issues branch assigns ISSUE_BODY and ISSUE_TITLE using GitHub expressions embedded directly in the run script.

quality.review_notes: The direct vulnerable and fixed action sources establish the interpolation-to-environment-variable remediation. The workflow trigger, intermediate reusable-action call chain, secret binding, and claimed execution/exfiltration impact are reported by the GHSL disclosure rather than supplied as immutable caller-workflow source or runtime logs. No exploit payload, execution trace, or passing regression test is bundled.

remediation.invariant_restored: Event-derived issue content is mapped into step environment variables and subsequently read as quoted shell variables, so the action no longer embeds issue expressions in its Bash assignments.
mitigation_classes: environment-variable transport of untrusted event data
removal of direct expression interpolation from Bash run text

oracle.expected_negative: The fixed pinned source maps those event fields through env and assigns ISSUE_BODY and ISSUE_TITLE from quoted EVENT_ISSUE_BODY and EVENT_ISSUE_TITLE shell variables.
oracle.expected_positive: The vulnerable pinned source contains direct issue-body and issue-title GitHub expressions inside the Bash issues branch assignments.
